title: Ocean Metrics indicators change: one row of a change file
description: One change at a place x indicator between two builds of the indicators catalog, read at the card's row (the status grain first, as @oceanmetrics/catalog pickRow), written by @oceanmetrics/catalog/changes diffCoverage to indicators/changes/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json and .parquet. `new`: the cell gained its first value; `status`: its status word changed (a word to another, a first word, or a word lost); `period`: its latest period advanced. A cell gives at most one row a day, in that order of precedence. Statuses are relative to the place's own record: no sentence says better or worse.

place_name.description: The place's name, from the coverage row.

coll.description: The values collection the row was read from (which values file holds it).

place_coll.description: The place's home gazetteer collection, its group; readers use `place_coll ?? coll`.

indicator.description: Indicator id, as indicators.json lists it.

kind.description: What changed: `status` (the status word), `new` (the first value), `period` (a later period).

time_grain.description: The grain of the card's row.

from_status.description: The status before; null when there was none.

to_status.description: The status after; null when there is none.

from_time.description: The last period before (its first day); null for a `new` row.

to_time.description: The last period after (its first day); null at the `all` grain.

value.description: The last value after the change.

unit.description: The value's unit, from the manifest; null when unknown.

not.description: a status is never better or worse

sentence.description: The change in words (changeSentence): the one wording for a feed entry, a mail line and the front page.

seen.description: The build date the change was seen, YYYY-MM-DD.

allOf.description: a status row has a status on at least one side, and the two differ (a reader check: the schema states the first half)

then.description: a status row has a status before or after

allOf.description: a new row has no earlier period and no earlier status
a period row has both periods
